value.title: Pipette: Improving Core Utilization on Irregular Applications through Intra-Core Pipeline Parallelism
value.edition: 13-page MICRO2020 author proceedings PDF;official MICRO53 program verified

value.locator: PDF pp4,6 §III-A TableII and §IV-A queue ownership
value.statement: Architectural register reads/writes map to blocking FIFO dequeue/enqueue;peek exposes the head without consuming ordinary data. Point-to-point queue ownership is one enqueuer and one dequeuer.
limitations: No authenticated executable simulator/RTL revision or numerical/performance measurement is supplied by this proposal.

value.statement: Control-bit entries redirect the dequeue/peek consumer to a user-level handler. skip_to_ctrl discards data through the next control value;when absent,it blocks and the producer next enqueue redirects to its control handler.
limitations: No authenticated executable simulator/RTL revision or numerical/performance measurement is supplied by this proposal.

value.statement: QRM maintains speculative/committed head/tail. Consumers use only committed producer values. Producer rollback releases speculative enqueue registers;consumer rollback restores speculative head. Consumer commit releases registers.
limitations: No authenticated executable simulator/RTL revision or numerical/performance measurement is supplied by this proposal.

value.statement: A configured reference accelerator consumes an index stream for A[i],or start/end pairs for half-open A[start:end),and produces returned values through its output queue. It uses the existing load/store unit and virtual addresses;faults interrupt its associated producer thread.
limitations: No authenticated executable simulator/RTL revision or numerical/performance measurement is supplied by this proposal.

value.statement: Evaluated reference uses148 QRM register entries,at most16 queues,default depth24,4 RAs and4 connectors. RA RTL includes a32-entry outstanding-load completion buffer. These are evaluated reference numbers,not 16 independent queues times24 storage.
limitations: No authenticated executable simulator/RTL revision or numerical/performance measurement is supplied by this proposal.

value.statement: Queue mapping cannot change while active. OS drains/saves architectural queues on deschedule;connectors enforce receiver capacity with credits and must quiesce before consumer deschedule.
limitations: No authenticated executable simulator/RTL revision or numerical/performance measurement is supplied by this proposal.

value.locator: PDFp7 §IV-A issue logic and §IV-B RA implementation
value.statement: Pipette retains standard ICOUNT thread prioritization. RAs opportunistically use spare rename and register bandwidth and existing load/store machinery. Queue-full/empty stalls preserve issue legality.
limitations: No authenticated simulator/RTL revision or measured issue/circuit cost supplied.

value.description: Committed inter-thread register queues with explicit configurable reference-access endpoints;no family-inherited operations.

value.name: Pipette MICRO2020 committed register queues and reference access

interface.software_supplies: Transformed pipeline stages,mapped input/output registers/queues,handler PCs and RA A/S/mode.

realization.description: Configure RA input/output queues,array base and element size;consume index orrange descriptors and return values through mapped queue registers.

result.form: Returned array values in an explicitly mapped inter-thread queue.
result.validity: Correct queue ownership,program mapping,address/type/bounds and producer-thread fault handling.

ordering.scope: Per point-to-point architectural queue;CPU programs obeyordinary memory consistency

Bind committed-only producer visibility and head/tail rollback/free register lifetimes.
Prove original VA/elementsize/index/range bounds and associated producer fault semantics.

internal_mechanisms.description: Physical register-backed circular queues with aggregate QRM allocation and separate head/tail pointers.
Only committed producer values available to consumers;full/empty blocking uses speculative versus committed frontiers.
Misspeculation rolls back local speculative pointers;producer rollback frees its speculative register allocations.
Uses existing SMT ICOUNT;RA opportunistically uses spare rename/register bandwidth and existing LSU.
RA returns into an output queue and reports VM fault toproducer;precise completion-order code binding remainsrequired.
Control-bit queue entries and producer/consumer handler redirects coordinate loop boundaries/cancellation.
Cross-core connector credits protect receiver capacity and require quiesce on deschedule.

limitations: No generic BFS default selection change or standalone arbitrary gather ABI.
No authenticated paper RTL/model code identity,FP type/order certification,performance orpaper circuit cost reproduced.
Abstract queue contract models committed/speculative subset;skip-to-control,handler restart,RA response-order and cross-core teardown microprotocols remain source/code obligations.
